verdict.rationale: Greptile exposes real programmatic surfaces — a CLI (`greptile review`, `greptile onboard`), an MCP server for fetching/resolving review comments, and a keyed REST API (api.greptile.com/v2/repositories) — showing meaningful non-UI parity for core review workflows. However there's no evidence of a full OpenAPI spec (probe found all candidate openapi.json paths 404'd) or documentation showing dashboard-only settings (strictness, custom rules, onboarding config, greptile.json overrides) are all controllable via API/CLI/MCP with true feature parity to the UI. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference showing coverage of all UI settings, explicit parity statement, and independent confirmation that dashboard-configurable features (strictness, custom rules) are settable outside the UI.
